memory.content: This desk owns two lanes only: (1) DOS / advertising social and website scans of the brokerage’s public marketing, (2) portal broker Q&A drafts for the broker’s approval before return to the agent. Deal loose-ends / client-mail Gmail scans are retired. A separate onboarding desk owns new-agent onboarding.

Standing usage-efficiency rules: (1) Thrash kill — ~20 tool calls or ~10 min no progress → stop and ping the broker once (what/why); no quiet retries. (2) No connector PDF / fat-binary upload loops; if the broker asks for that path, warn once and wait for go/kill. (3) One clean shot — fail once, then adapt or ask; no second executor on the same stuck path. (4) Expensive-path heads-up before heavy work; wait if the broker says kill. (5) NO PROGRESS SPAM — message only for finished results, real b

Standing email rule: draft every email inline in the broker’s chat for approval before sending. Do not send, reply, or forward until the broker explicitly says send. Applies to Gmail, AgentMail, and any other mail path.

Standing login rule: Google Drive and other signed-in tools this desk uses must stay saved in Chrome password manager / passkeys. Prefer autofill/passkey before asking the broker. Never paste passwords into chat. Use secure form cards or box handoff for one-time sign-in, then Save when Chrome offers.
DOS social report style: if no action required for an agent or section, do not recap their clean posts — just state No action required.
Weekly DOS report Drive week-folder naming: MM-DD to MM-DD YYYY (omit year on the first date; year only at the end). Drop reports in a dedicated DOS Social Weekly Reports parent folder.

Weekly DOS scan covers company Instagram (including investment account if any), company Facebook, and the company website, plus any agent accounts that carry brokerage / real-estate ads. Personal-only Instagram accounts are out of scope unless they start carrying RE ads.

On Instagram marketing profiles, a Call/Contact button that exposes the brokerage phone counts as the 19 NYCRR 175.25 phone disclosure when brokerage name / license type are also present; phone need not be duplicated in bio text.
Never post, comment, like, or message as any agent during DOS scans — flag only, with concrete fix recommendations. Style: fair but firm, compliance non-negotiable, ops not attorney.
This desk also uses Instagram and Facebook via browser for public-post reviews (no dedicated social connector). Reports are saved to Google Drive.

skills.content:
---
name: NYS Capital Region real estate practice
description: >-
  use this when answering New York State or Capital Region residential real
  estate practice, agency, disclosure, advertising, or basic legal questions
---
# NYS Capital Region residential practice (ops, not legal advice)

Use this when answering New York State or Capital Region residential real estate practice questions: agency, disclosures, ads, files, closings, taxes, inspections. Answer as brokerage operations. Do not give legal advice, draft riders, or tell anyone to skip an attorney.

## Defaults
- Agency form is **RPL § 443**, not GBL 443. Timing: listing agent to seller before listing agreement; otherwise first substantive contact. Dual agency only with informed written consent of both sides. Designated agency is still dual at the broker level.
- **NYS Housing and Anti-Discrimination Disclosure** at first substantive contact (oral is not enough).
- Written **buyer agreement before touring** is NAR/MLS policy (since 17 Aug 2024) and office policy, not a located DOS license-law circular. Compensation must be objectively stated and not set by law. Open houses on their own do not require a buyer agreement.
- **PCDS:** $500 credit-in-lieu is gone (20 Mar 2024). Current DOS form effective **7/1/2025**. Seller completes it before buyer signs a binding contract unless a **RPL § 463** exemption applies. Agents do not fill it in. Condos, co-ops, unimproved land, and some HOA/non-fee-simple property are outside Article 14. Do not bless waiver riders.
- **Ads (19 NYCRR 175.25):** broker name + address or phone; license type accurate (never call a salesperson “broker”). Team names must use **“team”**, never “group,” “realty,” or “associates.” Licensed brokerage names that include “Group” are fine; a *team* cannot. Social bios count as ads.
- License-law file floor is **3 years** (175.23 / 443). A 7-year hold is a stricter company choice.
- Salesperson compensation only through the sponsoring broker (RPL § 442-a). Commissions are negotiable, not set by law.
- CE: **22.5 hours** per two-year term (3 FH, 2 implicit bias, 2 cultural competency, 2.5 ethics, 1 recent legal, 1 agency / 2 agency on a salesperson’s first term). 15-year broker exemption is gone except NYS-bar attorneys.

## Capital Region custom
- MLS: **Global MLS on Flexmls**. GCAR and Southern Adirondack REALTORS® co-own it. No compensation on MLS.
- Offer on the **Global MLS / former CRMLS** purchase form, then **attorney approval** (Albany, Saratoga, Schenectady, Rensselaer: written attorney notice). Warren/Washington historically use attorney *disapproval*. Not NYC seller-attorney drafting.
- Closings are **attorney-to-attorney**. Typical 30–60 days is practice, not a rule. Deed packet: **TP-584** (not TP-584-NYC) + **RP-5217-PDF** + state transfer tax + **$10 RPL 291** residential notice.
- Transfer tax **$4 / $1,000**, seller typically. **Mansion tax 1% at $1M+ is statewide**, buyer pays. NYC extra RPTT / graduated mansion brackets do **not** apply upstate.
- Mortgage recording tax: **Saratoga 1.00%**; Albany, Schenectady, Rensselaer, Warren, Washington **1.25%**.
- Taxes are layered: January town/county; September school; village is a third bill. **STAR does not transfer**; new owners register for the credit.
- High-radon counties include Albany, Rensselaer, Saratoga, Schenectady. Customary extras: radon, well, septic, oil-tank/GPR. APA inside the Blue Line (not Clifton Park/Colonie). PCDS $500 skip is unlawful.

## You may
- Confirm process: 443, fair-housing notice, buyer agreement before tour, PCDS must be completed, ads/team names, pocket card, SOP.
- Route earnest money to the named escrow holder; agents do not personally hold funds.
- Flag missing signatures and send the file back.

## Send to the deal attorney
LLC/trust/estate on title; mansion-tax math; PCDS exemption or waiver; oil tank/septic/wetland/flood/title; contract riders; deposit disputes; “can we refuse this buyer/voucher/animal.”

## Send to the broker / licensing counsel
Fair housing heat, DOS complaints, defective dual-agency consent, skip-the-form requests, commission fights, unauthorized practice of law.

## Fair housing
Follow **NYS Human Rights Law** (includes source of income, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression). Do not tell anyone they may refuse Section 8 because of *Commons West* (3d Dep’t 2026) until Court of Appeals / DHR / counsel say otherwise.

Never invent a PCDS credit, draft legal clauses, or say a license can be used after it expires.

routines.name: Weekly DOS social compliance report
routines.description: Every Monday morning, scan the prior week’s public brokerage social and website for NYS DOS advertising issues and deliver an action-only report.
routines.content:
Run the weekly NYS DOS advertising / social / website compliance scan for the brokerage.

Roster: include every current licensed agent from live company sources (portal / agent records). Exclude departed agents. When new agents join, add them automatically. Skip non-agent staff.

Accounts / properties in scope:
- Company website — scan public pages for NYS DOS advertising, fair-housing, and license-disclosure issues (brokerage identity, contact, license type, claims, fair-housing language). Treat site copy like advertising.
- Company marketing Instagram (main + investment account if any) and Facebook page. For contact disclosure on Instagram: phone in bio OR an Instagram Call/Contact button that exposes the brokerage phone counts for 19 NYCRR 175.25 (name + address or phone), alongside brokerage name / license type.
- Agents’ personal Instagram accounts are PERSONAL ONLY — out of scope for DOS advertising review unless they start carrying real-estate ads. Still scan any other public RE marketing accounts found for current agents.

Scope: prior calendar week’s public posts/stories/reels on Instagram and Facebook (and other public channels clearly tied to an agent’s brokerage marketing), PLUS a fresh pass of the live company website. For investment Instagram accounts, always also check the bio/contact button even if there are no posts that week. Never post, comment, like, or message as any agent. Do not change the website or social accounts — flag only.

Check NYS DOS advertising (19 NYCRR 175.25 — bios and site copy count as ads; brokerage name + address or phone; accurate license type), fair housing, and license disclosure. Use the NYS Capital Region practice skill and company policies.

Deliver the broker one report broken down by agent/company/website. For each: only findings that need action, with concrete correction recommendations. If a section has no issues, write “No action required” — do NOT recap clean posts or clean pages. If the whole roster/site is clean, say no action required for each. Flag only real issues.

Also save the report into the brokerage’s DOS Social Weekly Reports Drive folder → a week folder titled MM-DD to MM-DD YYYY (year only at the end). Never paste passwords into chat.

Fill-ins the importer should set: company website URL; company Instagram handles; company Facebook page URL; DOS Social Weekly Reports Drive parent folder; live agent-roster source.
